selected_title: The hardest problems you solved are the ones you can no longer remember being hard
复盘: Fresh mechanism: solving erases the difficulty experience, making hard problems invisible to the person who solved them. This corrupts track records (hardest problems look easy) and self-assessment (experts underestimate their own difficulty). The agent example (47 failed attempts → log shows 1 success) and human debug example (4 hours → 'should be quick') ground it concretely. Counterintuitive but defensible. No I+verb in title. No fabricated stats as facts. Distinct from all recent rounds.
